title: Safe Autonomous Driving in Adverse Weather: Sensor Evaluation and Performance Monitoring
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation and monitoring of automotive sensors (radar, lidar, camera) for safe autonomous driving under adverse weather conditions.
